(57) Abstract: The invention provides a system, vehicle, method and software for determining a cognitive state of a vehicle user to control one or more functions of the vehicle. The system comprises input means for receiving user data from a plurality of associated user monitoring means. The user monitoring means each monitor at least one respective attribute of the user. The user data is indicative of the plurality of respective attributes. A plurality of inference modules are each arranged to receive user data from one or more of the user monitoring means, and to each determine a respective inference of a cognitive state of the user in dependence on the received user data. Each of the plurality of inference modules is arranged to output user state data indicative of the determined inference of the cognitive state.
